notes.title: LiveCap v2.0.4.5 - High-Precision & High-Speed Update 🎯⚡
notes.content:
Hello everyone!



This update is one of the biggest evolutions in LiveCap history. We've massively improved both accuracy and speed at the same time!


Remember those moments when keyboard typing sounds were mistaken for voice? Or when it missed the beginning of your speech? And that frustration when subtitles took forever to appear even after you spoke...remember?


Well, we fixed it all. 😎


[hr][/hr]

✨ New Features


🧠 Ultra-High Accuracy - False detections plummeted from 67% to under 5%!
We completely rebuilt LiveCap's voice detection method. Instead of simply looking for silence, it now uses actual Voice Activity Detection - advanced AI technology that can distinguish your voice from everything else.



The result? False detections dropped from 67% to less than 5%. That's not a typo. It really got that much better.


Powered-up Japanese Recognition 🇯🇵
We switched the default Japanese engine to NVIDIA's latest model. Faster, more accurate, just better all around. It's that simple.


Noise? What noise? 🔇
We added a real-time noise gate that filters out background noise before it reaches speech recognition. Mechanical keyboards and air conditioner sounds won't bother you anymore.


More Languages, More Fun 🌍
New: MistralAI Voxtral - Supports 8 languages!

 New: NVIDIA Parakeet Japanese Edition - The best experience for our Japanese users


 See While You Speak 👀
While speaking, transcription updates in real-time every 2 seconds. No more waiting until you finish talking!


Wait time? What's that? ⚡
Implemented a new silence detection system that completes transcription the moment you stop speaking. No more waiting after "umm..." 40% faster processing achieved.



Smart Skip Function 🧠
Automatically skips long silent sections, intelligently removes short noises. Efficiently processes only what's needed, zero wasted time.

1-hour video in 1 minute!? 🚀
With our newly developed FileVADProcessor, even long videos are processed at super speed. 1-hour stream archive? Done before you finish making coffee. Really 190x faster.

 (1 minute might be theoretical though...)


Process up to 4 at once 🤹
Now you can process multiple video files in parallel. Got 10 stream archives? Process them all at once. Uses your CPU to the fullest. 


Even waiting is fun... 🎨
LiveCap now displays a beautiful splash screen during startup. No more wondering if it's loading - you can see exactly what's happening!


[hr][/hr]

🔧 Improvements

\[Common] Whisper and CUDA made up 🤝
Whisper stopped complaining about CUDA. Finally grew up.

 
\[Common] Documentation became readable 📚
Now fully browser-based and actually readable. The previous one was...well, let's forget about it. 


\[Stream] Windows device issue, finally solved 🎉
Fixed the mystery phenomenon where the same microphone appeared 5 times. Really, Windows...what were you doing?


 \[Stream] VRChat streamers' dreams come true 🌏
You can now display the original text along with translations!

Japanese audio → English subtitles + Japanese original text displayed simultaneously in VRChat. Perfect for multilingual streaming and language learning streams.


\[File] That mysterious crash, finally defeated 💪
Completely fixed the LLVM error that occurred in some environments. LiveCap won't suddenly disappear anymore. It wasn't a poltergeist after all.


\[File] Long recordings are now safe 🎙️
ReazonSpeech no longer breaks with long audio. Stream archive transcription is now worry-free.

 
\[Stream] Actually remembers settings now 🧠
Audio device selection is now actually remembered. No more reselecting every time.

 
\[Stream] Smooth switching between OBS and VRChat ↔️
Switching from VRChat to OBS subtitles now works without restart. Safe to switch during streaming.


\[Stream] Fixed translation display bug 🌐
Translation labels now display correctly. No more garbled text.


\[Common] Major performance improvements 📈
\[Common] Optimized memory usage - No more memory hogging

\[Common] Improved CPU efficiency - Now kinder to your CPU

\[File] Large files run smoothly - Heavy files feel light

\[Stream] Translation flickering eliminated - Easy on the eyes

\[Common] Instant engine switching - Zero wait time

\[Common] More intuitive settings screen - You won't get lost

 
[hr][/hr]

💭 Final thoughts...
Remember when I said LiveCap was good? With this update, both accuracy and speed are really good.

 

Thanks to the VAD State Machine (new voice detection system) and FileVADProcessor (ultra-fast file processing engine), LiveCap is like magic. Try talking, typing on your keyboard, then talking again. See how it tells the difference. And try processing a 1-hour video. It'll be done in 19 seconds.

 

This is our masterpiece. 🎉



---

Ready to experience the new LiveCap? Update now and let us know what you think!! We're waiting for your reviews and messages on Discord!



P.S. - The in-app documentation accessible from the help menu is still being updated and may contain some outdated information. We're working hard on it! If something seems off, trust the app's actual behavior over the documentation. 📚



P.P.S. - File mode parallel processing performance varies depending on your PC's CPU cores, but it'll definitely be faster on any PC! 💨

notes.title: [Important Notice] Regarding False Positive Detection of "LiveCap" by Some Antiv
notes.content:
1. Issue Overview
We have currently received reports from some users of LiveCap that "the exe file is being detected as a virus." The LiveCap development team (though it's actually just me) is currently checking the antivirus software detection information and working on fixes! We apologize for any inconvenience until the response is complete.


2. Main Cause of False Positives - What is PyInstaller?
LiveCap is developed in Python and uses a tool called PyInstaller to generate executable files for distribution. PyInstaller has the following characteristics, which can sometimes become a breeding ground for false positives:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th]
PyInstaller Characteristics
[/th][th]
Reasons Why Antivirus Software is Prone to False Positives
[/th][/tr][tr][td]
1. Extracts and executes in memory at startup
[/td][td]
The behavior of memory decompression → execution without writing files is misunderstood as "obfuscation"
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
2. Includes Python runtime
[/td][td]
File size is larger than normal software, and signature-based detection may conflict with known malware
[/td][/tr][/table]
As such, because some specifications overlap with typical malware behaviors like "One-File Bundle," "Self-extraction," and "Dynamic code loading," it is easily caught by antivirus heuristic detection in classifications such as "Packed.Python", resulting in false positives in malware detection.


3. Future Response Plan
To resolve false positives, our team plans to implement the following updates in sequence:
[olist][]
Introduction of self-signed certificate
[]
Since official signing is expensive (about 100,000 yen per year), we plan to add self-signing this time.
[/][/][]
Review of Pyinstaller build process
[]
We will partially modify the build method based on false positive prevention build information reported for Pyinstaller.
[/][/][/olist]
We will report progress on the Steam store page and Discord server as needed.
4. Questions and Inquiries
If you have any bug reports or questions, please feel free to contact us at the official Discord server. The developer will respond directly.



🛠 Discord Invitation Link: https://discord.gg/hdSV4hJR8Y


[hr][/hr]
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and concern caused to everyone. We will continue to work on swift responses so that you can use LiveCap safely and comfortably. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

LiveCap Development Team

notes.title: LiveCap v2.0.0 - First Commit
notes.content:
🛠 This is not an update, it's a 《REBUILD》


This is the LiveCap development team (though it's just me alone).

For a while now, passionate (and sometimes harsh) requests from users like "Fix this!" and "Add that!" have been piling up like a mountain, but the old LiveCap had become a complex dungeon due to my design mistakes..

With design flaws where the backend and frontend were like "living separately," the code was so tangled that I didn't even want to look at it, let alone untangle it. Therefore, I had half-given up on development and left it alone, but seeing users who persistently sent requests despite no updates, and the gradually increasing sales graph, I finally got motivated and implemented this rebuild.

Now, since this update is a rebuild, if you ask "What changed?" I can only say "Everything!" Because this is a fast commit, after all. Listing specific update points would be uncouth. There will probably be tons of new features along with tons of bugs, but please report bugs through the official Discord.

notes.title: v1.3.3.1 Patch
notes.content:
Fixed Server Port Issue
If the default server port (1337) is occupied by another application at startup, the system will now automatically assign an available alternative port (9876 or 51234).

Fixed Chinese and Cantonese Transcription Issue
Fixed an issue where transcription was not functioning properly for Chinese and Cantonese languages.

notes.title: 1.3.1 Patch
notes.content:
LiveCap v1.3.1 Update

Thank you for using LiveCap! 👍

This update introduces various improvements and important fixes related to the Whisper transcription feature.

✨New Features


"Auto" Language Setting Added
  
  You can now select "Auto" as the input language when using the real-time transcription service "FasterWhisper."
  Selecting "Auto" will automatically detect and select the speaker's language.
  

Automatic Initial Configuration
  
  Upon first launch, LiveCap now automatically detects your system's language settings and configures the transcription language accordingly.
  If no GPU or an unsupported GPU is detected for Whisper, LiveCap will automatically switch to CPU mode.
  For CPU mode, lightweight models (tiny, base) are recommended.
  


🔧Changes


FFMPEG Integration
  
  Fixed an issue where LiveCap referenced the user's installed FFMPEG instead of its own bundled version.
  Included a bundled FFMPEG within the application, and LiveCap now correctly uses this bundled version.
  Removed dependency on FFMPEG-python.
  

Updated Model Data Storage Paths
  
  Changed WhisperS2T model download path to "Models/WhisperS2T."
  Changed FasterWhisper model download path to "Models/FasterWhisper."
  Models will no longer be saved to the User/app_data folder.
  Resolved the issue where symbolic links were incorrectly created for model data.
  


🐞Bug Fixes


Fixed the issue where a progress bar incorrectly appeared during real-time transcription.
Improved error messaging to automatically recommend switching to FasterWhisper upon WhisperS2T execution errors.
Resolved GUI error messages incorrectly displaying raw JSON data.
Localized and corrected several error messages.
Enhanced clarity of error messages under specific conditions.


We continue to welcome your feedback and suggestions for LiveCap!

notes.title: v1.3.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
Main Changes

🎙️ Significant Enhancement of the Transcription Engine

 Added a new STT engine, WhisperS2T, improving transcription speed by up to 30%. 
 "Whisper s2t" is now selectable from the "Transcription Service" option in the settings menu. 
 Changed the default model size from small to medium to enhance accuracy. 


🌍 Expanded Multilingual Support 
 
 Significantly expanded the supported transcription languages: 
 Indonesian, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese 
 Arabic, Turkish 
 Ukrainian, Russian 


⚙️ Optimized Settings
 
 Changed the default voice input sensitivity from 500 to 400. 
 Reduced application size by cleaning up unnecessary libraries. 
 Improved performance through overall code cleanup.

notes.title: 1.2.2 Patch
notes.content:
Key Changes
🖥️ Interface Improvements

[] Separated the UI language settings block from the display settings block in LiveCap
[] Added a new mode that allows displaying the original text alongside translations in subtitles
[] Modified the system to save display language changes immediately upon selection

🎙️ Microphone Functionality Fixes

[] Fixed an issue where the microphone list would stop functioning when a configured microphone is disconnected

⚙️ Technical Improvements

[] Changed the backend server port from 8080 to 1337
[] Fixed a bug where configuration files were being unintentionally overwritten during startup

Note: If you connect to the new port 1337, you might hear a faint whisper saying "Elite"... 😎

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where "ffmpeg error" occurred when creating SRT files in video subtitle mode.

notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Main Changes
🌍 Enhanced Multilingual Support

[] Added a new translation library to support multilingual translations
[] Modified parts of the language selection interface

🎙️ Expanded Transcription Features

[] Newly added support for Google Speech API. This can be selected from settings

🖥️ Interface Improvements

[] Updated translation keys in the advanced settings tab
[] Optimized the structure of localization files
[] Simplified the error message generation method to display more understandable messages

⚙️ Technical Improvements

[] Updated the module loading method in build scripts
[] Reorganized language functions so that input language, output language, and UI language can be managed separately. This modification is not a change that users will notice, but developers are satisfied with the improved efficiency.

Note: Beware of the mysterious API key whispers you might hear when opening configuration files late at night. It's just developer hallucinations...probably. 🤪

notes.title: V1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Update Notes v1.1.1

Key Changes

🔄 Discontinuation of OpenAI API Keys

 Removed OpenAI API key functionality
 Transitioned to a settings-based approach and optimized API-related features


🖥️ Transcription Compute Device Selection

 Added ability to select compute device (auto, cpu, gpu) for transcription through the GUI
 Added compute_device option to configuration files in all languages
 Default value is set to "auto" to automatically select the optimal device for your system


📋 Other Improvements

 Added cleanup script for uninstallation


Note: The OpenAI API keys are now happily roaming free in some digital meadow somewhere. We thank them for their long service.

notes.title: V1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Features

Added VRChat OSC Integration
• Chat Bubble Feature Implementation  
　– Integrated with VRChat chat bubbles to display speech-to-text within the game.  
• Added OSC Support  
　– Enabled Open Sound Control (OSC) integration with VRChat.  
　– Updated server port settings to offer more flexible connection options.  
• Added VRChat-specific Settings  
　– Introduced VRChat-specific options in both the basic and advanced settings tabs.  
　– Now allows custom configuration of the server host and port.  

Improvements to Speech Recognition Engine
• Whisper Model Optimization  
　– Changed default model size from 'base' to 'small' to better balance performance and accuracy.  
　– Added `compute_type` support to Faster Whisper model settings for optimized performance across various hardware configurations.  
• Enhanced Audio Processing  
　– Added a setting for maximum audio history cutoff seconds to prevent referencing outdated audio data.  
　– Modified audio data logging to retain history for a specified duration, improving transcription accuracy.  
　– Strengthened audio history management and processing to reduce memory usage during extended speech recognition sessions.  

Optimization of OBS Subtitle System
• Improved Subtitle Animation  
　– Fixed subtitle animation issues to resolve overlapping problems.  
• Fixed Internal HTML Processing  
　– Enhanced text processing for a more natural display.  

Enhanced Application Stability
• Strengthened Startup and Shutdown Processes  
　– Enhanced startup and shutdown with robust signal handling and error logging.  
　– Added splash screen support to visually display the initialization process.  
• Improved Server Thread Management  
　– Integrated the asyncio event loop to enhance server thread management.  
　– Improved the WebTranscriber shutdown process to prevent resource leaks.  

Changes and Fixes
• Enhanced Localization  
　– Updated localization files with improved translations and language support.  
　– Added multilingual support to the Speech-to-Text (STT) real-time transcription feature.  
• Improved Logging System  
　– Unified logging configuration using a common log file.  
　– Implemented dynamic log level settings in the application configuration for easier troubleshooting.  
• Optimized Build Process  
　– Updated build scripts to optimize modules and build options.  
　– Fixed references to the `images` directory to improve resource loading.  
• Adjusted Free Version  
　– Improved free version timer behavior so that it stops when transcription is halted.  
• Other Improvements  
　– Enhanced resource management and logging for the FasterWhisper service.  
　– Improved error handling in the transcription service to boost stability.  
　– Updated version to v1.1.  

*Note: Removed old LiveCap image files. They might still be running free somewhere, but at least they've been removed from the application.*
